description: This file defines an enum for chat transport events, a protocol for chat transport operations, and default implementations for the protocol's methods that throw errors when not supported.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Default no-op implementation for setting active session key.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Default implementation that throws an error indicating reset session is not supported.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Default implementation that throws an error indicating compact session is not supported.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Default implementation that throws an error indicating abort run is not supported.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Default implementation that throws an error indicating listing sessions is not supported.

methods.name: listModels
methods.description: Default implementation that throws an error indicating listing models is not supported.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Default implementation that throws an error indicating setting session model is not supported.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Default implementation that throws an error indicating setting session thinking level is not supported.
